item.title: One for the record books: Billy Joel sells Long Island estate for $28.75M
item.description: After three years of having his 26-acre waterfront Centre Island estate sit on the market, Billy Joel has finally sold his house. The $28.75 million sale, handled by Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Laffey International Realty, was reportedly the most expensive real estate sale in Long Island history, outside of the Hamptons. item.description: New York state and federal officials have filed a lawsuit against the owners of Harbourview Shoppes, alleging the Roslyn shopping center has been illegally discharging pollutants into Hempstead Harbor in violation of environmental laws. item.title: Plandome Heights proposes 6.2% tax increase
item.description: The Village of Plandome Heights Board of Trustees proposed to raise taxes to 6.2% at its Monday, March 2, meeting. item.title: Justin Timberlake Sues Sag Harbor to Block Release of DWI Arrest Video
item.description: Pop star and actor Justin Timberlake is suing the Village of Sag Harbor and its police department to prevent the release of body camera footage from his 2024 drunken driving arrest.

item.title: Congestion pricing lives on as judge rules that Trump admin’s effort to kill it was unlawful
item.description: Congestion pricing survived yet another challenge Tuesday after a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's attempt to kill the Manhattan toll program is unlawful.
